borderWidth.$description: Stroke thickness roles. Pick by the job of the line, not by desired weight.

default.$description: Standard outline of a control or container: outlined buttons, chips, input strokes at rest.

focus.$description: Thickness of the focus ring around the focused element. Geometric half of the focus indicator; the color half lives with the theme roles.

hairline.$description: The thinnest visible line: separators, dividers, subtle outlines. Approximates a true one-physical-pixel hairline on current display scales; a scale-resolved value would be exact, this is the tokenized compromise.

strong.$description: Emphasized stroke: selected or active state, error outline, decorative rings that must read clearly.
